Animal Bite Center

Animal Bite Center

Fast, professional care for dog, cat, and other animal bites — anti-rabies vaccination, wound treatment, and follow-up monitoring from licensed medical staff.

🕒 Open daily, 8AM–6PM 📍 Kapitolyo Health Center 🏠 Home service available
About this service

The Animal Bite Center (ABC) connects you to accredited clinics equipped to handle animal bite exposures. Our medical staff assess every case, provide anti-rabies and tetanus vaccination when needed, and guide you through the full post-exposure treatment schedule so you never miss a dose.

Available Services
Anti-Rabies Vaccination
Post-exposure vaccine doses following the DOH-recommended schedule.
Animal Bite Consultation
Risk assessment of the bite incident and personalized treatment advice.
Wound Assessment & Treatment
Cleaning, disinfection, and dressing of the bite wound.
Tetanus Vaccination (if applicable)
Administered based on wound severity and immunization history.
Follow-up Checkups
Scheduled visits to complete your vaccination series and monitor healing.
